requirements.text: The crate outer envelope is 160 mm long x 120 mm wide x 90 mm tall.
All crate walls are 3 mm thick.
The crate is a hollow container with a floor and four walls, open at the top.
Each of the four side walls has exactly one row of six ventilation slots (24 slots total).
Ventilation slots cut completely through the wall thickness.
The six slots on each side are identical in size, evenly spaced, and arranged in a single horizontal row centered on the wall.
Ventilation slots stay fully within the wall faces and do not break through the corners, floor, or top rim.
A stacking lip is located on the top rim of the crate, running around the perimeter.
The stacking lip is sized to fit inside the bottom of an identical crate, with its outer profile smaller than the crate's inner cavity/bottom recess so crates nest and stack.
The underside of the crate is shaped (recess or inner clearance) to receive the stacking lip of an identical crate.
The crate is modeled as a single solid body.
The stacking lip does not obstruct the ventilation slots.
